Geni — Spudic surname index (67 profiles, all 4 pages) + Polovich (30) / Polovic surname pages; opened Vid Spudic x2, Stephen John, Marko, Nicholas Spudich, George Jurg Spudich, Juraj (George) Polovic, Josip Polovic, Marko Polovic
note: No Geni profile links Janko (b.~1889-91) or Dora Polović. Both Geni 'Vid Spudić' profiles are Neretva-area (Metković/Lukovac) and do not fit. Stephen John Spudic is a US-born line (Taylor/VanSandt), no fit. Found a Polović family of Žabljak, Karlovac: Juraj (George) Polovic b.16 Mar 1885 Žabljak, d.6 Nov 1939 White City IL, buried Mt Olive; parents Josip Polovic (1853-1934) & Magdalena Grman; Josip's parents Janko Polovic & Barbara Biscan; siblings Marko (1876-1947), Ivan x2, Jana; wife Kata Valent, 10 children (Nicholas, Joseph, Mary Rita, Michael...). Managed by Curtis Gene Leonhardt. Link to Dora/Barbara Polovich NOT shown.

src: MyHeritage — historical-record and tree search 'Vid Spudic' and 'Janko Spudic b.1891 Croatia' (free results page only, first 20 each; 3.29M hits unfiltered, not walked)
note: Trees list Vid Spudić b.8 Jan 1828 Leskovac Barilovićki (Curlovic tree: d.'1869?', son Mijo Josip 'Michael'; FamilySearch Family Tree: parents Johannes 'Janko' Spudić c.1801 & Ana Pavletić, wife Jelena Aršulić, daughter Jana, many siblings). All unsourced tree data. Also 1913 Ellis Island line (22 Apr 1913, Janko Spudic b.~1889, Leskovac, father Janko Spudic at home, joined brother Marko Spudic). Other Leskovac Vids (b.1715, c.1763, c.1771, c.1777, c.1829 m. Ana Radinović, 1839-41) are earlier or later generations.
